title: ProfilesGetInput
description: The member to read. `userId` is the opaque durable account id (`user:<id>`) in the RUN's tenant — the same key the `ctx.features.profiles.getProfile` surface reads. An EMPTY or absent id is a typed `validation_error` node failure (never a success with `profile: null`); a real id that is not found in the tenant is an explicit `{ profile: null, found: false }`.
